description: This file contains core functions for an ATM driver, including device initialization, configuration, data transmission, reception handling, and hardware interaction for a Linux-based embedded system. It manages ATM connections, descriptors, and hardware registers, and integrates with the Linux kernel's ATM subsystem.

methods.name: ppe_ioctl
methods.description: Handles IOCTL commands for ATM device, providing MIB statistics and VCC info.

methods.name: ppe_open
methods.description: Opens an ATM VCC, allocates resources, sets up QSB, and enables hardware interrupts.

methods.name: ppe_close
methods.description: Closes an ATM VCC, releases resources, and disables hardware interrupts if needed.

methods.name: ppe_send
methods.description: Transmits an ATM cell or AAL5 packet, setting up descriptors and signaling hardware.

methods.name: ppe_send_oam
methods.description: Sends an OAM cell over ATM, managing descriptors and signaling.

methods.name: ppe_change_qos
methods.description: Updates QoS parameters for an ATM VCC, adjusting QSB settings.

methods.name: atm_showtime_enter
methods.description: Enters 'showtime' mode, configuring hardware for active data transfer.

methods.name: atm_showtime_exit
methods.description: Exits 'showtime' mode, restoring hardware to idle state.

methods.name: ltq_atm_probe
methods.description: Initializes the ATM driver on device detection, setting up hardware, devices, and IRQs.

methods.name: ltq_atm_remove
methods.description: Cleans up driver state, deregisters devices, and releases resources on device removal.
